name: How long does it take to install new flooring for aging in place renovations?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new flooring for aging in place renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for installing new flooring depends on the type of material, the size of the area, and any necessary subfloor preparations. For an average-sized room (e.g., 200-300 sq ft), luxury vinyl plank (LVP) or carpet installation might take 1-3 days. Tile installation, which involves setting and grouting, typically requires 3-5 days, including drying time. Larger projects or those requiring significant subfloor repairs, leveling, or old flooring removal will extend the duration. A detailed project schedule will be provided after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for aging-in-place flooring typically ranges from 1-5 days per area, depending on material, room size, and subfloor preparation needs.
